idea-z01.name: Schedule an annual preventive health check
idea-z01.description: Write down questions and symptoms beforehand so the appointment is easier to use well.

idea-z02.name: Build a simple morning mobility routine
idea-z02.description: Start with five minutes for shoulders, hips, and ankles.

idea-z03.name: Prepare a weekly medication and supplement organizer
idea-z03.description: Refill it every Sunday evening and make a note before anything runs low.

idea-z05.name: Track energy levels after meals for two weeks
idea-z05.description: Record the meal, time, energy level, and anything unusual without trying to make the notes perfect.

idea-z06.name: Book a dental hygiene appointment
idea-z06.description: Check whether a follow-up examination is due as well.

idea-z07.name: Create a calmer evening wind-down routine without phones or work notifications
idea-z07.description: Dim the lights, prepare tomorrow's essentials, and read something relaxing for at least fifteen minutes.

idea-z08.name: Keep fruit visible on the kitchen counter
idea-z08.description: Make the easy choice the healthy choice.

idea-z09.name: Review caffeine timing
idea-z09.description: Try moving the final coffee earlier and observe whether falling asleep becomes easier.

idea-z10.name: Learn one balanced breakfast that takes less than five minutes to prepare
idea-z10.description: Choose ingredients that can stay stocked and require almost no cleanup on a busy morning.

idea-z11.name: Take a short daylight walk
idea-z11.description: Especially useful on days spent mostly indoors.

idea-z12.name: Create an emergency healthy meal for the freezer
idea-z12.description: Prepare enough portions for the days when there is no time or energy to cook.

idea-z13.name: Measure resting heart rate consistently for one month
idea-z13.description: Use the same time and conditions, then look at the trend rather than individual readings.

idea-z14.name: Try a screen-free lunch once a week

idea-z15.name: Write a reusable grocery list organized by store section
idea-z15.description: Include reliable sources of protein, vegetables, fruit, whole grains, and quick snacks.

idea-z16.name: Check desk ergonomics and monitor height
idea-z16.description: Adjust the chair, screen, keyboard, and lighting, then notice whether neck or wrist tension changes.

idea-z17.name: Plan recovery time after especially demanding weeks
idea-z17.description: Protect at least one quiet block for sleep, food preparation, movement, and genuinely restorative downtime.

idea-z18.name: Keep a compact first-aid kit stocked
idea-z18.description: Check expiration dates and replace anything that has been used.

idea-z19.name: Practice slow breathing before stressful meetings
idea-z19.description: Use a short, repeatable pattern that is easy to remember and discreet enough to do anywhere.

idea-z20.name: Choose one sustainable health habit instead of attempting a complete lifestyle overhaul all at once
idea-z20.description: Pick the smallest behavior that would still matter, define when it happens, and keep it easy enough to repeat on difficult days.

idea-7.name: Keep a consistent bedtime
idea-7.description: Aim for seven to eight hours.

idea-10.name: Write down one clear next step

idea-12.name: Review one Android API
idea-12.description: Take notes about when to use it.
